visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two individuals are positioned in a bright furniture showroom. On the left, a man with glasses and a grey t-shirt stands near a white height-adjustable desk, his hand gesturing near the control panel on the desk's edge. Opposite him stands a female employee wearing a black vest over a white shirt and a protective white mask, holding her hands together at her waist. The background features large windows showing a street with passing cars and greenery, suggesting an urban setting. (2) The camera remains relatively static as the man continues to interact with the desk surface. The female employee maintains eye contact, her facial expressions showing attentiveness through her eyes as she wears a mask. As the conversation progresses, her eyes crinkle and she tilts her head slightly, indicating a shift from professional listening to genuine laughter. The desk surface holds a laptop, a keyboard, and promotional materials. (3) Large, bold yellow and white text overlays dominate the upper and lower portions of the frame. The female shop assistant is shown in a closer shot, laughing uncontrollably at the man's jokes. The lighting is bright and even, typical of a professional retail environment, with shadows being soft and diffuse.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male voice speaks with a moderate, steady tempo, describing technical specifications of a desk. His tone is informative and neutral. In the background, a light, upbeat pop/lo-fi track plays with a steady 4/4 electronic drum beat. (2) The male voice delivers a pun regarding 'Vivaldi's Four Seasons'. His pitch variability increases as he emphasizes the punchline. A female voice responds with a polite, laughing 'Yes'. The background music continues consistently without interruption. (3) The man delivers a second narrative joke about military exercises and children sitting on desks. His tone is teasing and comedic. The female voice breaks into genuine, high-arousal laughter, with audible breathiness and stuttering 'Why?'. (4) A deep, processed male voiceover laughing 'Hehe haha' enters, accompanied by a slight swell in the background music volume. This transition signals the end of the comedic interaction.
